title: Is Machine Learning Speaking my Language? A Critical Look at the NLP-Pipeline Across 8 Human Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity in NLP pipeline support across 8 languages by comparing the availability of pre-trained NLP tools (BERT, Word2Vec, NLTK, Wikipedia2Vec), calculating the ratio of Wikipedia articles per 1000 speakers to assess resource representation, and measuring disparities in error rates during data processing steps like XML parsing and Optical Character Recognition (OCR).
